## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer
- Design tokens as CSS variables → map to the project's token system
- Raw hex colors / absolute positioning → the design is loosely structured;
  use the screenshot

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring or one-time remote agent ("run this every Monday", "open a cleanup PR for X in 2 weeks"), or to manage existing routines. ALSO OFFER PROACTIVELY: after you finish work that has a natural future follow-up, end your reply with a one-line offer to schedule a background agent to do it. Strong signals: a feature flag / gate / experiment / staged rollout was just shipped (offer a one-time agent in ~2 weeks to open a cleanup PR or evaluate results), a new alert/monitor was created (offer a recurring agent to triage it), a TODO/migration with a "remove once X" condition was left behind (offer a one-time agent to do the removal). Skip the offer for refactors, bug fixes, and anything that is done once it ships. Name a concrete action and cadence ("in 2 weeks", "every Monday") and only offer when the run just succeeded — do not pitch a schedule for something that has not happened yet.
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.

- train: Extract lessons from the current session and update the memory brain.

- verdict-30d: 30-day post-launch decision: SCALE, PIVOT, or KILL. No middle ground.
- research: Run competitive intelligence research on any product category or idea.
- validate-only: Market and business model validation for a Scout-approved idea. Takes ~1 week.
- shape-only: 2-day kill test for a raw SaaS idea. Fast validation before investing time.
- saas-cycle: Full SaaS idea-to-verdict pipeline. Takes an idea from raw concept through build, launch, and mea...
- caveman:caveman-review: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.
- caveman:caveman: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

Auto-triggers when staging changes.

Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman:compress <filepath> or "compress memory file"

Now let me summarize my findings and create the audit report. Based on my exploration, here's what I've found:

## Inventory Data Layer Map – InkOS

### **File Tree**
```
app/api/inventory/
├── dashboard/route.ts                 # GET: Calls RPC get_inventory_dashboard
├── items/route.ts                     # GET/POST: List, create inventory items
├── items/[id]/route.ts                # GET/PATCH/DELETE: Item CRUD (soft-delete)
├── items/[id]/adjust/route.ts         # POST: Adjust stock → inventory_movements insert
├── movements/route.ts                 # GET: List stock movements + joins
├── purchase-orders/route.ts           # GET/POST: List, create POs
├── purchase-orders/[id]/route.ts      # GET/PATCH: View, update PO
├── purchase-orders/[id]/receive/route.ts # POST: RPC receive_purchase_order
├── stock-alerts/route.ts              # GET/PATCH: List alerts, mark acknowledged
├── suppliers/route.ts                 # GET/POST: List, create suppliers
├── suppliers/[id]/route.ts            # GET/PATCH/DELETE: Supplier CRUD
└── stocktake/route.ts                 # Stub endpoint

lib/dashboard/
└── low-inventory.ts                   # Server query: filters items where current_stock < min_threshold

lib/billing/
└── feature-gate.ts                    # Gate: inventory = 'studio' tier minimum

hooks/dashboard/
└── use-inventory-alerts.ts            # useQuery → /api/inventory/dashboard
```

### **Database Schema (from types.ts)**

**inventory_items**
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id, studio_id, supplier_id | uuid | PK, FK→studios, FK→suppliers |
| name, sku, barcode | text | Unique(studio_id, sku) |
| category | enum: ink/needle/supply/aftercare/equipment/apparel/other | |
| brand, color, size, unit | text | |
| current_stock, min_threshold, max_stock | int | min_threshold defaults 0 |
| cost_per_unit_cents, retail_price_cents | int | Cents, not floats |
| location_id | uuid | FK→locations (nullable) |
| is_active, is_retail | bool | Soft-delete via is_active=false |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamptz | |
| **FK:** location_id→locations, supplier_id→suppliers | | |
| **No indexes** on (min_threshold, current_stock) for alerting | | |

**inventory_movements**
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id, studio_id, item_id | uuid | PK, FK→inventory_items |
| qty_delta, qty_after (MISSING) | int | Direction of movement |
| reason | enum: purchase/session_use/adjustment/waste/return/stocktake/other | |
| performed_by | uuid | FK→profiles (nullable) |
| booking_id | uuid | FK→bookings (nullable, for session_use) |
| unit_cost_cents | int | Cost basis at time of movement |
| reference, notes | text | Audit trail |
| created_at | timestamptz | Immutable |
| **Bug:** adjust/route.ts inserts `qty_after` field not in schema | | |

**purchase_orders** (PO state machine)
| Column | Type | Values |
|--------|------|--------|
| id, studio_id, supplier_id | uuid | FK→suppliers (nullable) |
| order_number | text | Unique(studio_id, order_number) |
| status | enum | **draft, ordered, partial, received, cancelled** |
| ordered_by | uuid | FK→profiles (nullable) |
| ordered_at, received_at | timestamptz | Timestamps of state transitions |
| expected_delivery_at | timestamptz | ETA |
| total_cents | int | Sum of line items |
| notes | text | |

**purchase_order_lines**
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id, purchase_order_id, item_id | uuid | FK→purchase_orders, FK→inventory_items |
| qty_ordered, qty_received | int | Partial receive tracking |
| unit_cost_cents, total_cents | int | |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamptz | |

**stock_alerts** (implied table, referenced in stock-alerts/route.ts)
| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id, studio_id, item_id | uuid |
| acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by | timestamp, uuid |
| notes | text |

**studio_ink_registry** (Ink Passport)
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id, studio_id, supplier_id | uuid | FK→suppliers |
| brand, color | text | **NOT linked to inventory_items** |
| batch_number, product_code | text | Tracking |
| manufacture_date, expiry_date | date | Compliance |
| reach_compliant | bool | EU regulation |
| sds_url | text | Safety sheet |
| created_at, updated_at | timestamptz | |

### **RPC Functions** (referenced in API routes)
- `receive_purchase_order(p_po_id uuid, p_lines array)` – Update PO status + inventory_movements
- `get_inventory_dashboard(p_studio_id uuid)` – Returns JSON dashboard data

### **Mutations** (API endpoints)
✅ **Implemented:**
- addItem: POST /items
- updateItem: PATCH /items/[id]
- deleteItem: DELETE /items/[id] (soft-delete)
- adjustStock: POST /items/[id]/adjust → writes inventory_movements
- createPurchaseOrder: POST /purchase-orders
- markPOReceived: POST /purchase-orders/[id]/receive (RPC)
- addSupplier: POST /suppliers

✅ **Queries:** All gated via `requireFeature(plan, 'inventory')` at 'studio' tier minimum

---

## **Bugs Mapped to Audit Issues**

| P0 Bug | Root Cause | Layer |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| **Brand/Color showing "—"** | `studio_ink_registry` has no FK to `inventory_items`. Ink registry is a *separate* table (brand/color manual entry), not linked to SKUs. No JOIN exists in UI. | Data layer: missing relationship |
| **Stock Alerts "All clear" when items low** | `min_threshold` defaults to 0 in schema. Low-inventory detection filters `current_stock < min_threshold`. If min=0, almost no items trigger alerts. Also: no alert auto-creation trigger on low stock. | Data layer: wrong default value |
| **Movements not auto-logging from Adjust Stock** | Comment in adjust/route.ts says "inventory_movements INSERT triggers handle_check_low_stock" but: (1) insert includes `qty_after` field not in schema, (2) trigger likely missing or fails silently. Action layer *writes* movement correctly, but trigger may be broken. | DB trigger: missing or broken |
| **Supplier UUID leak** | suppliers query at line 50 of suppliers/route.ts returns full supplier rows including `id`. Safe (already constrained by studio_id), but not a join—just denormalized data. No privacy leak here. | Safe; non-issue |

### **Feature Gate Check**
✅ **inventory: 'studio'** — enforced in:
- Every GET/POST/PATCH route via `requireFeature(plan, 'inventory')`
- Dev mode: pass-through (feature-gate.ts:131 returns null)
- Gating on purchase_orders, suppliers, movements works correctly

### **Audit Trigger Status**
❓ **Not found:** No trigger to log mutations to `audit_log` on inventory mutations. Flash pieces has one (s13_flash_inventory.sql:388), but inventory system has no equivalent.

**Verdict:** Core schema exists but is **under-connected** (ink registry orphaned) and **under-integrated** (no auto-alerts, no audit triggers, broken movement trigger).

| 8 | Open POs tab | Each row shows "3 items · $280". One-click Mark received on row. Overdue POs flagged Rust. |
| 9 | Click "Add to PO" on alerts (3 items, 2 suppliers) | Two PO drafts created (grouped by supplier). Owner reviews, hits Submit, status flips to Ordered + email sends. |
| 10 | Open Suppliers tab | Each row shows Last order + YTD spent. Row actions reveal View / Edit / New PO. |

## Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| `studio_ink_registry` backfill match fails for some rows | Backfill matches on `(LOWER(brand), LOWER(color), studio_id)`. Unmatched rows leave `item_id NULL` and surface in admin panel for manual link. No data loss. |
| Existing `min_threshold = 0` rows keep alerts silent | Migration includes one-time advisory: select count of items with `min_threshold = 0`, log to admin announcement. Owners see "Alerts can't fire" empty state until they bulk-fix. No silent break — explicit prompt. |
| Cards-view users (if any) lose layout | Telemetry suggests <2% engagement. Removal communicated via in-app changelog. |
| `create_po_from_alerts` RPC creates duplicates if double-clicked | Idempotency key on `(studio_id, hash(item_ids), date_trunc('hour', now()))`. Second call returns first PO. |
| Audit trigger floods `audit_log` on bulk import | Throttle: skip audit when `pg_trigger_depth() > 1` (i.e., the change came from a parent trigger). |

---

- Multi-location stock allocation (Sprint 13).
- Barcode scanner integration (existing `barcode` field stays text, no camera UI yet).
- Supplier portal / EDI integration.
- AI re-order forecasting (Pro+ feature, separate brief).
- Stocktake module changes (`/inventory/stocktake` untouched).

---

1. **Default min thresholds per category** — proposed: ink:3, needle:20, supply:5, aftercare:5, equipment:1, apparel:5, other:3. Confirm or override?
2. **PO `from-alerts` flow** — should submitting drafts auto-email suppliers (Resend) on Phase 2, or stay as draft-only until Phase 3 ships email templates?
3. **Existing items with `min=0`** — silently default-fill on first dashboard load, or force the owner to confirm via the "ALERTS CAN'T FIRE" empty-state CTA (current proposal)?

| [components/ui/badge.tsx](components/ui/badge.tsx), `card.tsx`, `dialog.tsx`, `sheet.tsx`, `scroll-area.tsx` | shadcn primitives — extend, don't fork. |
| `~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md` | Load on every touch. RPC-only writes for audit tables (3A). Dual-layer feature gate (4). |

---

## Sequencing (ship order — P0 → P1 → P2)

### Phase 1 — P0 ship blockers (Dato + Koda, ~1 day)

1. **Dato** writes migration `inventory_p0_fixes.sql`:
   - `studio_ink_registry.item_id` FK + index + backfill
   - `min_threshold` CHECK >= 0
   - Low-stock audit trigger (creates `stock_alerts` row when crossing threshold)
   - Remove `qty_after` from any RPC that references it
2. **Dato** runs `pnpm db:migrate` then `pnpm db:types`. Hands off.
3. **Koda** edits `app/api/inventory/items/[id]/adjust/route.ts` to drop `qty_after` write.
4. **Koda** edits `ItemForm.tsx`: `min_threshold` defaults per category, save blocked when `min=0`.
5. **Koda** edits `ItemsTable.tsx` GET path to surface Brand/Color via the new FK join when `category=ink`.
6. **Koda** edits `StockLevelBadge.tsx` to three-state Rust/Rust-outline/Stone-outline.
7. **Koda** edits `InventoryHub.tsx` to drop Cards toggle + `viewMode` state.
8. **Koda** edits `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx` to drop Stock/Ink Registry top-level `PageTabs`.
9. **Luna** writes regression tests: alert fires when stock drops below min · ink registry brand/color populated · adjust stock writes a movement row.

**Quality gate:** Sage signs off Phase 1. Five P0 blockers cleared.

### Phase 2 — P1 ops upgrade (Koda + Vega, ~1.5 days)

10. **Koda** ships `InventoryKPIStrip.tsx` + extends `dashboard/route.ts` RPC.
11. **Koda** ships `app/api/inventory/stock-alerts/add-to-po/route.ts` + `create_po_from_alerts` RPC (Dato writes the RPC migration).
12. **Koda** rebuilds `StockAlertsPanel.tsx` with row schema + bulk Add to PO + two empty states.
13. **Koda** ships `BulkThresholdsDrawer.tsx` + `bulk-thresholds` API route.
14. **Vega** reviews KPI strip + Stock Alerts redesign against Brand v1.0 (one Rust accent per viewport rule, tabular-nums on every number, Stone uppercase labels).

### Phase 3 — P2 polish (Koda, ~1 day)

15. **Koda** edits `PurchaseOrdersTable.tsx`: line-count column, status pills for draft/cancelled, per-row quick actions, overdue Rust flag.
16. **Koda** edits `SuppliersTable.tsx`: last-ordered + YTD spent columns + row actions.
17. **Koda** edits `ItemsTable.tsx` filters: explicit Category + Supplier + Stock dropdowns with labels. Per-row Reorder action when below min.
18. **Koda** folds Ink Registry into Items as a filter view (`?category=ink` shows Batch / Expiry / SDS columns), then deprecates `components/reach/InkRegistryTable.tsx`.
19. **Koda** drops `retail_price` field from ItemForm unless `category=apparel` or `is_retail=true`.

**Quality gate:** Sage final review. Hawk monitors post-deploy.

---

## Brand-v1.0 Compliance Checklist (Vega gate)

- KPI strip: Inter 800 / 32–52px / tabular-nums numbers, Stone uppercase 11px / `tracking-0.08em` labels.
- Below-min KPI gets the **single** Rust 2px left border per viewport.
- Stock pills: Rust filled (`bg-rust text-bone`) below min · Rust outlined (`border-rust text-rust`) within 25% · Stone outlined (`border-stone-brand/40 text-foreground`) healthy.
- Empty-state titles: Instrument Serif italic ("*Inventory within healthy range*", "*No minimums set*").
- Overdue PO flag: small Rust pill ("Overdue · 3 days") — never a full-row Rust fill.
- No gradients · no default Tailwind shadows · no raw hex literals.
- One Rust accent per viewport — recount before merge.

---

## Verification (end-to-end)

```bash
# Local dev
pnpm install
pnpm db:migrate
pnpm db:types
pnpm db:seed:demo:reset       # deterministic demo studio
pnpm dev                       # http://localhost:3000

# Static gates
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm build

# Tests
pnpm test                      # Vitest — alert firing, min validation, ink registry join
pnpm test:e2e                  # Playwright — the audit's QA checklist below
```

### QA checklist (Luna writes E2E tests for these)

| # | Test | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open Items tab | Stock pill Rust-filled below min, Rust-outlined within 25%, Stone otherwise. Value column shows cost × stock. Bulk-select per row. |
| 2 | Open Add Item form | `min_threshold` pre-fills per category (ink:3, needle:20, supply:5, etc.). Save disabled if min=0. Supplier dropdown shows names, never UUIDs. |
| 3 | Adjust Stock on any item | Stock count updates + Movement row auto-created with delta + reason + user + timestamp. No `qty_after` schema error. |
| 4 | Open Movements tab | Every Adjust Stock + every PO Mark-received appears. Source distinguishes manual vs PO vs sale. |
| 5 | Stock Alerts with items below min | Each alert shows current/min/suggested reorder/supplier/+ Add to PO. |
| 6 | Stock Alerts when no Min set | Empty state distinguishes "all clear" from "alerts can't fire". CTA links to bulk-edit. |
| 7 | Open Items tab with `?category=ink` | Brand + Color populated. Three extra columns appear: Batch · Expiry · SDS. |
| 8 | Open POs tab | Each row shows "3 items · $280". One-click Mark received on row. Overdue POs flagged Rust. |
| 9 | Click "Add to PO" on alerts (3 items, 2 suppliers) | Two PO drafts created (grouped by supplier). Owner reviews, hits Submit, status flips to Ordered + email sends. |
| 10 | Open Suppliers tab | Each row shows Last order + YTD spent. Row actions reveal View / Edit / New PO. |

---

## Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| `studio_ink_registry` backfill match fails for some rows | Backfill matches on `(LOWER(brand), LOWER(color), studio_id)`. Unmatched rows leave `item_id NULL` and surface in admin panel for manual link. No data loss. |
| Existing `min_threshold = 0` rows keep alerts silent | Migration includes one-time advisory: select count of items with `min_threshold = 0`, log to admin announcement. Owners see "Alerts can't fire" empty state until they bulk-fix. No silent break — explicit prompt. |
| Cards-view users (if any) lose layout | Telemetry suggests <2% engagement. Removal communicated via in-app changelog. |
| `create_po_from_alerts` RPC creates duplicates if double-clicked | Idempotency key on `(studio_id, hash(item_ids), date_trunc('hour', now()))`. Second call returns first PO. |
| Audit trigger floods `audit_log` on bulk import | Throttle: skip audit when `pg_trigger_depth() > 1` (i.e., the change came from a parent trigger). |

---

## Out of Scope (explicit non-goals)

- Multi-location stock allocation (Sprint 13).
- Barcode scanner integration (existing `barcode` field stays text, no camera UI yet).
- Supplier portal / EDI integration.
- AI re-order forecasting (Pro+ feature, separate brief).
- Stocktake module changes (`/inventory/stocktake` untouched).

---

## Open Questions for Yash

1. **Default min thresholds per category** — proposed: ink:3, needle:20, supply:5, aftercare:5, equipment:1, apparel:5, other:3. Confirm or override?
2. **PO `from-alerts` flow** — should submitting drafts auto-email suppliers (Resend) on Phase 2, or stay as draft-only until Phase 3 ships email templates?
3. **Existing items with `min=0`** — silently default-fill on first dashboard load, or force the owner to confirm via the "ALERTS CAN'T FIRE" empty-state CTA (current proposal)?

## Migration 1 — `[ts]_inventory_p0_fixes.sql`

Goal: link `studio_ink_registry` to `inventory_items` so Brand/Color stop rendering "—". Enforce min_threshold >= 0.

```sql
-- Add FK + index
ALTER TABLE studio_ink_registry
  ADD COLUMN item_id uuid REFERENCES inventory_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_studio_ink_registry_item_id ON studio_ink_registry(item_id);

-- Backfill: match on (studio_id, LOWER(brand), LOWER(color)) for ink-category items
UPDATE studio_ink_registry r
SET item_id = i.id
FROM inventory_items i
WHERE i.studio_id = r.studio_id
  AND LOWER(TRIM(i.brand)) = LOWER(TRIM(r.brand))
  AND LOWER(TRIM(i.color)) = LOWER(TRIM(r.color))
  AND i.category = 'ink'
  AND r.item_id IS NULL;

-- Constraint
ALTER TABLE inventory_items
  ADD CONSTRAINT inventory_items_min_threshold_nonneg CHECK (min_threshold >= 0);

-- RLS: studio_ink_registry rows must match studio_id of joined inventory_items.
-- Use a row-level CHECK trigger if existing RLS doesn't cover the cross-table consistency,
-- otherwise rely on existing policies (inspect existing policies first).
```

After writing: report rows backfilled vs unmatched (so we know how many need manual link in admin panel).

## Migration 2 — `[ts]_inventory_low_stock_trigger.sql`

Auto-create stock_alerts row when current_stock crosses below min_threshold; auto-resolve when stock returns at/above min.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_inventory_low_stock_handler()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Only act when min_threshold > 0 (alerts can't fire when min is 0)
  IF NEW.min_threshold > 0 AND NEW.current_stock < NEW.min_threshold THEN
    INSERT INTO stock_alerts (studio_id, item_id, created_at)
    VALUES (NEW.studio_id, NEW.id, now())
    ON CONFLICT (studio_id, item_id) WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL DO NOTHING;
  ELSIF NEW.current_stock >= NEW.min_threshold THEN
    UPDATE stock_alerts
       SET acknowledged_at = now(), notes = COALESCE(notes, '') || ' [auto-resolved]'
     WHERE item_id = NEW.id AND acknowledged_at IS NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_inventory_low_stock
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_stock, min_threshold ON inventory_items
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_inventory_low_stock_handler();
```

Inspect actual `stock_alerts` schema first — the partial unique index `(studio_id, item_id) WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL` may not exist; create it if needed for the ON CONFLICT to work, otherwise restructure with a SELECT-then-INSERT in the function.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_inventory_low_stock_handler()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Only fire when min_threshold > 0
  IF NEW.min_threshold > 0 AND NEW.current_stock < NEW.min_threshold THEN
    INSERT INTO stock_alerts (studio_id, item_id, created_at)
    VALUES (NEW.studio_id, NEW.id, now())
    ON CONFLICT (studio_id, item_id) WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL DO NOTHING;
  ELSIF NEW.current_stock >= NEW.min_threshold THEN
    UPDATE stock_alerts

     WHERE item_id = NEW.id AND acknowledged_at IS NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_inventory_low_stock
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_stock, min_threshold ON inventory_items
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_inventory_low_stock_handler();

Single SQL preferred. Use `LEFT JOIN LATERAL` or two parallel queries merged in JS — whichever is cleanest.

Approach: parallel fetch (suppliers + aggregated PO stats by supplier_id), merge in JS. Avoids any nested-select Supabase quirks.

```ts
const [suppliersRes, statsRes] = await Promise.all([
  supabase.from('suppliers').select('*').eq('studio_id', studioId),
  supabase
    .from('purchase_orders')
    .select('supplier_id, total_cents, ordered_at, status')
    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
    .in('status', ['ordered', 'partial', 'received'])
    .not('supplier_id', 'is', null)
]);

const yearStart = new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 0, 1).toISOString();
const stats = new Map<string, { last: string | null; ytd: number }>();
for (const po of statsRes.data ?? []) {
  const cur = stats.get(po.supplier_id!) ?? { last: null, ytd: 0 };
  if (!cur.last || po.ordered_at > cur.last) cur.last = po.ordered_at;
  if (po.ordered_at >= yearStart) cur.ytd += po.total_cents ?? 0;
  stats.set(po.supplier_id!, cur);
}

const items = suppliers.data!.map(s => ({
  ...s,
  last_ordered_at: stats.get(s.id)?.last ?? null,
  ytd_spent_cents: stats.get(s.id)?.ytd ?? 0,
}));

- View: always
- Edit: `status === 'draft'` only

- Cancel: `status === 'draft' || status === 'ordered'`

1. `booking_id !== null` → "Session use" (highest priority)
2. `reason === 'purchase'` → "PO receive"
3. `reason === 'session_use'` (no booking_id) → "Session use"
4. `reason === 'stocktake'` → "Stocktake"
5. Everything else (`adjustment`, `waste`, `return`, `other`) → "Manual"

Sprint 5 frontend final shipment for InkOS Inventory in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS.

Plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/inventory-page-lets-deep-enchanted-peach.md (Sprint 5 tasks 2, 3, 4, 5).
Lessons: ~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md.
Brand v1.0: project CLAUDE.md (Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust, Inter/Instrument Serif, no `any`, no raw hex, tabular-nums, no default Tailwind shadows).

Dato shipped extended `get_inventory_dashboard` RPC. Returns `Json` (treat as typed via interface cast). Verified demo studio values:
- `total_value_cents: 593050` → $5,930
- `below_min_count: 3`
- `pos_in_flight: 4`
- `spent_30d_cents: 70000` → $700

## Task 1 — NEW `components/inventory/InventoryKPIStrip.tsx`

Server-fetched dashboard data passed via prop (server component pattern). Card grid: 2 cols mobile, 4 cols desktop.

```tsx
type KPIStripData = {
  total_value_cents: number;
  below_min_count: number;
  pos_in_flight: number;
  spent_30d_cents: number;
};

type Props = { data: KPIStripData };
```

Layout per card (use existing `<Card>` shadcn primitive or compose div with `border border-border rounded-md bg-bone shadow-soft p-6`):

```
[STONE UPPERCASE LABEL · 11px · tracking-0.08em]
[ONYX NUMBER · Inter 800 · 32px mobile / 52px desktop · tabular-nums]
```

The four cards:
1. **TOTAL STOCK VALUE** — `formatCurrency(data.total_value_cents)`
2. **BELOW MIN** — `${data.below_min_count} item${data.below_min_count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
   - **Single Rust accent rule:** when `below_min_count > 0`, add a 2px Rust left border (`border-l-2 border-l-rust`). When 0, no Rust accent — keep card normal.
3. **POS IN FLIGHT** — `data.pos_in_flight`
4. **SPENT · 30D** — `formatCurrency(data.spent_30d_cents)`

Stone label color: `text-stone-brand` or whatever the existing token is. Recheck `app/globals.css` `@theme inline` for the exact token name.

NEW skeleton: `components/inventory/InventoryKPIStripSkeleton.tsx` — matching grid + 4 placeholder cards with shadcn `<Skeleton />` for label + number.

## Task 2 — wire KPI strip into `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx`

The page is a server component (verify — it should be, given S2 changes used `searchParams`). Fetch dashboard data server-side:

```ts
const { data: dashboard, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_inventory_dashboard', { p_studio_id: studioId });
const kpiData = (dashboard as KPIStripData | null) ?? {
  total_value_cents: 0, below_min_count: 0, pos_in_flight: 0, spent_30d_cents: 0,
};
```

Type the cast cleanly:
```ts
type DashboardJson = { total_value_cents: number; below_min_count: number; pos_in_flight: number; spent_30d_cents: number; /* other existing fields */ };
const kpiData = dashboard as unknown as DashboardJson;
```

Render `<InventoryKPIStrip data={kpiData} />` between PageHeader and InventoryHub. Wrap in `<Suspense fallback={<InventoryKPIStripSkeleton />}>` — though if the RPC is fetched in the same server component, Suspense wrapping is on the consumer side. Use whichever pattern matches Stack A best practice (likely: fetch in page.tsx, pass static props, no Suspense needed since it's blocking on the page render).

If the RPC fails or returns null, render the strip with zeros — never crash the page.

## Task 3 — bulk-select on `components/inventory/ItemsTable.tsx`

Add bulk-select pattern matching Stock Alerts panel from Sprint 3.

### Checkbox column (sticky left)
- Header checkbox: select-all visible page.
- Per-row checkbox: `checked` state in component.
- Use shadcn `<Checkbox />` primitive.

### Sticky bottom action bar
When `selectedIds.size >= 1`, render a fixed-bottom bar (Bone surface, Stone hairline border, `shadow-soft-md`):

Left: `{N} selected` Stone label.

Right buttons (in order):
- **Add {N} to PO** Onyx primary → POST `/api/inventory/stock-alerts/add-to-po` with `{ item_ids: Array.from(selectedIds) }` → on success toast `Created {po_ids.length} draft PO(s)` + clear selection + refresh items.
- **Bulk thresholds** outline → opens `<BulkThresholdsDrawer mode="manual">` from Sprint 3 (already exists). Pre-populate the drawer with selected items if drawer supports it; otherwise drawer opens to its default behaviour.
- **Archive** Rust outline → confirm dialog "Archive {N} items? They'll be hidden but data preserved." → DELETE on each (or batch endpoint if exists, otherwise loop). On success toast + refresh.
- **Clear** Stone outline → empty selection.

### State
- `const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())`
- Toggle helper: `(id) => setSelectedIds(prev => { const next = new Set(prev); next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id); return next; })`
- Reset on filter change (when filters change, items list changes; clear selection).

### Note
The `add-to-po` endpoint already accepts arbitrary item_ids from anywhere in the app (Sprint 3 made it studio-membership-checked). Reuse it directly.

## Task 4 — verify K2 (top-bar total stock value)

The audit said the existing top bar in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` shows total stock value. Confirm:
1. Open `app/(app)/layout.tsx`. Search for "stock value" or any inventory total reference.
2. If wired: confirm the value source. If it's a separate query, swap to consume the same `get_inventory_dashboard` RPC (avoid drift between top bar and KPI strip).
3. If NOT wired: leave a TODO comment in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` near where it would go: `// TODO Sprint 6: wire total stock value from get_inventory_dashboard RPC into top bar.`

Don't introduce new top-bar logic in this sprint if missing — the KPI strip on the inventory page is the new authoritative surface. The top-bar is a nice-to-have if it exists; if not, document and move on.

## Quality bars
- Zero `any`. Cast `Json` RPC response via `as unknown as DashboardJson`.
- Zero raw hex literals.
- Zero default Tailwind shadows.
- One Rust accent per viewport on inventory page: BELOW MIN card border (when count > 0) is the one. The Reorder buttons and overdue PO pills count as additional contextual Rust — that's OK since they're conditional/per-row.
- Tabular-nums on every number in the KPI strip.
- Run `pnpm typecheck` end. Report delta only for files you touched.

## Out of scope
- Backend route changes (none planned for S5).
- DB / RPC / migrations (Dato shipped S5 piece).
- Movements log / suppliers / POs (S4 shipped).
- Stock alerts panel (S3 shipped).

## Report back
- Diff summary per file.
- Confirm KPI strip values match Dato's smoke test ($5,930, 3 items, 4, $700 for demo studio).
- Confirm BELOW MIN Rust border only when count > 0.
- Confirm bulk-select toggles + sticky bar + Add-to-PO call works.
- Top-bar status (already wired vs TODO left).
- Typecheck delta.
